name: visibility-fanout
fault_schedule: Each actual loopback visibility partition handler holds until all4 independently entered; one separatecase returns InvalidArgument while siblings await controlled release.
assertions: LIST initial partition reads and COUNT all4 execute concurrently before release.
A partition error joins outstanding client calls without peer cancellation and never returns partial success.
limitations: Deterministic RPC control, not real SlateDB/S3 performance or a completed cold-runtime rerun.
Live cross-partition semantics and existing30s deadline retained; no snapshot claim.
